title: Sauce de bocko (Baobab Leaf Sauce with Meat)
author: Tata Ngome et al. (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré)
desc: Meat cooked and fried, then simmered with onions, tomatoes, garlic, pepper and salt for 10 minutes, cooking water and dalang added, and dried baobab-leaf powder cooked 10–15 minutes.
longDesc: p. 68 of the October 2023 recipe book. The meat is cooked then fried; onions, tomatoes, garlic, pepper and salt go in and simmer 10 minutes; the cooking water and dalang are added; dried baobab-leaf powder is added and cooked 10–15 minutes. No quantities are printed.
ingredients: Dried baobab-leaf powder — quantity not printed
Water, oil, onion, garlic, ginger, salt, chilli, dalang — quantities not printed
Fresh tomatoes — in the method, not in the list; quantity not printed
steps: Cook the meat, then fry it.
Add the onions, tomatoes, garlic, pepper and salt and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the cooking water and the dalang.
Add the baobab-leaf powder and cook 10–15 minutes.
chefTips: No doneness cue is printed beyond the times.
The tomatoes appear in the method but not in the ingredient list.
commonMistakes: Adding the powder all at once so it clumps.
Leaving out the tomatoes because the list omits them.
healthBenefits: Baobab leaf is a dried leafy green.
culturalNote: The book attributes its recipes to the northern part of Cameroon and names no community, lamidat or town for any recipe.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Sauce de bocko (feuille de baobab) à la viande’ (p. 68). Authors as printed: ‘Tata Ngome et al.’ (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré; ReSI-NoC project); October 2023 (V1), © 2024, CC BY 4.0. Yield not printed for any recipe in the book. Servings 6, prep are placeholders. SINGLE-PASS for the text.
ABSENT: every quantity; the tomatoes are in the method but not the list.
